preferences: The human-facing Supervisor must use the planning provider preference by default when bootstrapping the internal Lead seat; never create that Lead with a stock provider.
Use planning_pilot only when the Human explicitly requests the Sonnet Lead pilot. Mark that Lead with lead_profile=pilot; otherwise use planning and lead_profile=stable.
The Claude Lead pilot uses Sonnet 5 1M at Max thinking with a 300000-token auto-compact window. Treat 1M as headroom, not a target working set.
The Lead must use the impl, impl_deep, search, research, or ui provider preference when creating a bounded Peer; never create an internal Peer with the stock codex provider.

Use impl (DeepSeek V4 Flash) for normal, mechanical, isolated implementation. Use impl_deep (Codex Peer Luna) for difficult, cross-cutting, or uncertainty-heavy implementation; use audit (Codex Peer Luna) for review. For codex-peer impl_deep or audit work, request Max thinking.
Use search (Codex Peer Luna) for delegated codebase navigation/search and request Low thinking. Direct rg/GitNexus calls stay inside the current agent and do not spawn another model.
Use ui (Gemini through Antigravity ACP) for UI/design work; prefer gemini-3.6-flash-medium unless the task needs another advertised Gemini mode.
DeepSeek V4 Flash and GLM 5.2 on the AI Box provider are configured with Max thinking; do not invent an unsupported no-thinking option for them.
Verify the created agent's provider and model immediately after creation. If it is a stock provider or the wrong role provider, stop and report the routing error instead of continuing the chain.
